newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AT&T-Unisource set for boost from STET.
newsitem.headline: AT&T-Unisource set for boost from STET.

text.p: AT&T-Unisource, the joint venture between AT&T Corp and European telecoms group Unisource NV, should receive a big revenue boost by a partnership with STET/Telecom Italia, AT&T chief John Walter said on Wednesday.

"The business plan with AT&T-Unisource has certain benchmarks going forward from a stand-point of revenue. By adding STET to this relationship with AT&T Unisource we've in fact accelerated the revenue growth by 30 percent going forward which will allow us to accomplish $2.0 billion in revenue in the next five years," he said in a telephone interview.
Walter, speaking ahead of a news conference in Italy to amplify on the STET/Telecom Italia deal, said it formed part of a strong focus AT&T had placed on its global platform.

"The fact of the matter is that STET brings some very strong capabilities, a very important market and very strong technical skills," Walter said, adding it would help form a strong alliance to do business in Latin America.

"What it also does is increase...our capabilities in meeting the needs of European customers. The fact of the matter is by adding STET to AT&T-Unisource, this very important alliance increases our business plan," he said. -- Keiron Henderson, Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
